cualitativo.comentario_factsheet: [Contexto Amiral Gestion 2019, NO sobre FR001400CEG4 — fondo no existía aún] Raphaël Moreau (portfolio manager Sextant PME en Amiral Gestion) comenta en RankiaPro nº0 (Dic 2019): 'There has been a strong polarization between Growth/Visible stocks vs. cheap, value stocks... driven by low or negative long term interest rates... Companies that are not stamped as being growth or visible by investors have significantly suffered from the big uncertainties created by the trade war and Brexit... A recession might be a boon for value stocks... Valuation in the industrial part of the market has reached extreme lows, as many stocks trade currently at similar capital employed multiples as they were at the end of 2008.' Filosofía Amiral Gestion: 'We seek excellence in our investments... Co-invest with our investors following the value philosophy for 15 years. Independence, focus on asset management using fundamental analysis of companies.' Posiciones de convicción mencionadas en 2019: Jacquet Metals, Picanol, Plastic Omnium, Altri, Ence. Filosofía aplicable a Sextant Quality Focus (creado posteriormente).
